#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf."""
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER = "cover.pdf"

# --- Inspect the input document ---
reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
original_pages = len(reader.pages)
print(f"Original document: {INPUT} ({original_pages} pages)")

# --- Build the cover page ---
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover date: {today}")

c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.3)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 60, "Annual Financial Report")
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.3)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 + 30, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 + 30)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 20, today)
c.save()

# --- Merge cover + original pages ---
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages "
      f"({len(writer.pages) - original_pages} cover page added)")

# --- Verify the output ---
check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
print(f"Verification: {OUTPUT} has {len(check.pages)} pages")
page1_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("Cover page text:", repr(page1_text))
assert "Annual Financial Report" in page1_text, "Title missing on cover page"
assert today in page1_text, "Date missing on cover page"
print("Verification passed: title and date present on cover page.")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page with title and current date to report.pdf."""
from datetime import date

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER = "cover.pdf"

# --- Inspect the input document ---
reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
original_pages = len(reader.pages)
print(f"Original document: {INPUT} ({original_pages} pages)")

# --- Build the cover page ---
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter
today = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Cover date: {today}")

c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.3)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 60, "Annual Financial Report")
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.1, 0.1, 0.3)
c.setLineWidth(1.5)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 + 30, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 + 30)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 20, today)
c.save()

# --- Merge cover + original pages ---
writer = PdfWriter()
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT} with {len(writer.pages)} pages "
      f"({len(writer.pages) - original_pages} cover page added)")

# --- Verify the output ---
check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
print(f"Verification: {OUTPUT} has {len(check.pages)} pages")
page1_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("Cover page text:", repr(page1_text))
assert "Annual Financial Report" in page1_text, "Title missing on cover page"
assert today in page1_text, "Date missing on cover page"
print("Verification passed: title and date present on cover page.")
